description: Provider guide page 5-1 (Provider Monitoring - Reviews and Audits): a centered page title, bold run-in sub-headings, two bullet lists, and a dash sub-list under 'Claim Payment accuracy reviews'.

items: Site visits performed by provider relations and credentialing staff, usually related to questions or concerns
Audits to ensure compliance with use and disclosure of confidential information
Claim audits as necessary to resolve questions or disputes that arise related to billing
Standard claim audits on behalf of self-funded employer groups

assertions.xfail: The page title and the bold sub-headings are all h2: 'Types of audits' sits at the same level as the page title it belongs under.
The dash sub-list under 'Claim Payment accuracy reviews, including:' is flattened into that bullet's text instead of a nested list.

items: Claim reviews related to high-dollar services and medications
Pre- and post-payment coding compliance audits
Credit balance reviews for account overpayments and incorrect reimbursement
